module: Generic persistent key/value store, with secondary indexes built on demand. Each "store" is registered under a name with a (unique) primary key field and stored in a file <path>/<prefix->name.bin (MessagePack; the JSON format exists in the code but USE_MSGPACK is true). It serves as a data cache (the code mentions a UI cache) and allows searching entries by any field, following relation chains (getChain) and rewriting the file on each modification.
usage:
util_datastore.register('myStore', 'id', {path = '/temp'})
util_datastore.putEntries('myStore', {{id = 'a', color = 'red'}, {id = 'b', color = 'red'}})
local reds = util_datastore.getEntries('myStore', 'color', {'red'})
notes: For an unregistered store, most functions return a failure table {ok = false, err = 'store_not_registered', storeName = ...} (not nil). Test with isUnregisteredFailure(result).
The file is read only on first access (lazy loading); a truncated or unreadable file gives an empty store. Written files contain only entries (array of tables); order is not guaranteed.
Default path: /temp; default primary key: 'name'. Paths are normalized (slashes, no trailing slash). With a non-empty opts.prefix, the file becomes <prefix>-<storeName>.bin.
Read-only store (opts.readonly = true): putEntries, removeEntries and clear return false without writing.
Secondary indexes are multivalued (several entries per value) and built on first use of a field, then maintained on each putEntries/removeEntries. nil values are not indexed.

getChain starts from a "seed" entry then follows in depth the chainField field (array of keys), resolving each key in the chainResolveField field (set by setChain), without duplicates; returns the list of entries found, seed first.
Hot reload: onSerialize keeps only the registrations (path, fields, read-only, chain), not the entries, which are re-read from the file.
register reuses the chain configuration of a previous registration of the same name. The extension goes into manual unload (onInit).

register.desc: Registers (or re-registers) a store in memory; does not load the file.

primaryField.desc: Unique primary key field, 'name' by default.

opts.desc: {path = folder (default /temp), prefix = file prefix, readonly = boolean}.

returns.desc: false if the name is invalid, otherwise true.

unregister.desc: Removes the in-memory registration without touching the file.

isRegistered.desc: Returns whether a store is registered.

isUnregisteredFailure.desc: Returns whether a result is the "store_not_registered" failure.

returns.desc: true if it is that failure.

getEntry.desc: Returns the first entry whose field equals value.

returns.desc: Entry, nil if absent, or failure table if the store is not registered.

getEntries.desc: Returns the entries whose field equals one of the values, without duplicates (deduplicated by primary key).

values.desc: List of values; a non-table value gives an empty list.

getIndex.desc: Without primaryKey: list of the distinct values present for the field. With primaryKey = true: table primary key -> field value for each entry (not deduplicated).

primaryKey.desc: true for the table keyed by primary key.

returns.desc: List or table, or failure table.

getAll.desc: Returns all the entries of the store (order not guaranteed).

hasEntry.desc: Returns whether at least one entry has this field equal to value.

returns.desc: true if found (or failure table if the store is unknown).

getChain.desc: Looks up a seed entry then follows its relation chain (chainField/resolveField set by setChain), without cycles.

field.desc: Field used to find the seed.

returns.desc: Seed then linked entries; empty if the seed does not exist.

putEntries.desc: Inserts or replaces entries (identified by the primary key), updates the indexes and rewrites the file. Entries without a primary key are ignored with a warning.

returns.desc: true if something changed; false if read-only, invalid argument or nothing to write (or failure table).

removeEntries.desc: Removes the entries whose field equals one of the values, then rewrites the file.

clear.desc: Empties the store and rewrites the (empty) file.

returns.desc: true; false if read-only; failure table if not registered.

setChain.desc: Defines how to follow relations for getChain: chainField contains an array of keys, resolved via the field field.

chainField.desc: Entry field containing an array of linked keys.

field.desc: Field in which to look up each key.

onInit.desc: Initialization hook: sets the extension to manual unload.

onSerialize.desc: Hot reload hook: serializes only the stores' registrations (not the entries).

onDeserialized.desc: Hot reload hook: recreates the stores from the saved registrations (entries to re-read from the file).
